name: Gigwell
long_description:
Gigwell is building the operating system for the concert & live events industry.

Our platform modernizes the way live entertainment is booked and managed by helping booking agencies, venues, promoters, festivals, and talent buyers replace fragmented spreadsheets, emails, PDFs, and disparate tools with a single centralized booking hub. Gigwell streamlines artist and venue management, offers, contracts, advancing, tour logistics, payments, reporting, and communication in a collaborative platform purpose-built for the complexities of live events.

Trusted by more than 100,000 artists and venues, Gigwell has facilitated over $5 billion in bookings across live music, comedy, public speaking, digital creators, and entertainment. Gigwell has built one of the first vertically integrated SaaS infrastructure platforms designed specifically for live entertainment bookings, positioning the company to become the core infrastructure layer powering the future of live events globally.

Gigwell has been featured in TechCrunch, Billboard, DJ Mag, Mixmag, Hypebot, DJ Times, and Magnetic Magazine, and was recognized as the Most Promising Startup by the Nitey Awards and SF MusicTech’s Startup Innovators Challenge.
one_liner: Building the Operating System for the Concert & Live Events Industry.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Jeremie Habib is the Co-Founder and CEO of Gigwell, a digital booking platform that streamlines the booking process between live entertainers and event venues. The company has streamlined over $5B in gigs for DJs, musicians, comedians, and public speakers. Prior to launching Gigwell, Jeremie held senior Sales & BD positions at Cisco and several early-stage SaaS companies like OpenDNS where he helped grow the company from 0 - $100 m in revenue.
